title: After a resume, the cloud install does not work inside the live pin
why: Coordinator, Oct 31 18:47 CDT: after each resume, the coordinator's shell stood in the live pin, /home/user/claude-settings-live-<sha>; seen 4 times that day. Ruling 1 of decision merge-reinstalls-from-main: no lane, review or merge work runs in the pin. Measured cause (lane, via coordinator 19:34 CDT): on resume, `install.sh --cloud` took the pin as its source and ran git checkout in it. A hook cannot move the shell's folder, so what moved the shell itself is unmeasured. Lead: resumes rooted at /home/user, where a cd into the pin persists.
note: Built: draft PR #915, queued for the batch runner (coordinator, Nov 1 19:34 CDT Oct 31). Likely in normal work: every resumed cloud session runs the install. Done check: a resume test shows `install.sh --cloud` never takes the pin as its source and runs no git checkout in it, red on main and green on the fix. Open: what moves the shell into the pin. Needs no answer. Files: hooks/install.sh, hooks/session_start.sh, hooks/test_cloud_setup.sh. Linked: step cloud-merge-moves-pin, step frozen-path-ref-delete.
